The Sudeten German conference is taking place for the first time in the Czech Republic and has sparked controversy and local protests. In 1945 and 1946 Czechoslovak authorities, who accused Sudeten Germans of having supported the brutal Nazi occupation of Bohemia and Moravia, expelled approximately three million ethnic Germans and confiscated their property following the end of World War II.
